time: seconds after midnight of the service day 20260625; trips inside the domain during [start - 600 s, end]
interpolation: linear in distance along path between the departure from one station and the arrival at the next (constant speed; no acceleration profile); stationary between arrival and departure (GTFS gives none). station_offsets_m are distances along path from its first point (negative / beyond its length for the outside neighbour stations); a train is shown only while its distance lies in [0, path length]. A trip split into runs has ids <gtfs trip id>#k
provenance: scheduled positions interpolated between timetabled station calls; not real-time. Viewers interpolate linearly in distance along the pattern path between departure and arrival (no acceleration profile).
